name: Only Mutual Devotion Grants the Right to Love
original_name: Only Mutual Devotion Grants the Right to Love
overview: Heiress Cen Wan, after a bet, wins over Shen Qingci, the poor but handsome campus heartthrob at Ocean University, in just three days. Unbeknownst to her, Shen Qingci is her high school classmate who has secretly loved her for six years. After they fall in love, numerous conflicts arise due to their class differences, Xie Yu's interference, and Shen Qingci's obsession. Cen Wan breaks up with him and is briefly imprisoned by Shen Qingci. Later, Shen Qingci is severely injured by Xie Yu, and Cen Wan flees abroad. Six years later, Shen Qingci returns as a business tycoon seeking revenge. Cen Wan, having fallen on hard times, returns to China, and the two reunite. Shen Qingci agrees to help Cen Wan reclaim everything on the condition that she stays by his side. Through their interactions, past misunderstandings are resolved, and they eventually come together, enjoying a happy family life four years later
